lessons.name: Unit 1: A Long and Healthy Life

questions.question: Regular physical exercise and a balanced diet are essential for building a robust _______ system against common diseases.
questions.explanation: 'Immune system' is the bodily system that protects against infectious organisms and diseases.

questions.question: The doctor strongly advised him to cut down on processed foods and take _______ yoga to alleviate work stress.
questions.explanation: 'Take up' is a phrasal verb meaning to start a new hobby, interest, or healthy activity.

questions.question: Many adolescents nowadays suffer _______ chronic sleep deprivation due to excessive late-night screen time.
questions.explanation: The verb 'suffer' collocates with the preposition 'from' when referring to an illness or difficult condition.

questions.question: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others: /ɪ/ vs /aɪ/
questions.explanation: In 'fitness', the letter 'i' is pronounced /ɪ/, whereas in 'diet', 'lifestyle', and 'vital', it is pronounced /aɪ/.

questions.question: Bacterial infections can be treated effectively with _______ prescribed by certified physicians.
questions.explanation: 'Antibiotics' are medications specifically designed to inhibit the growth of or destroy bacteria.

questions.question: She _______ jogging around the lake every morning since she joined the athletic club three months ago.
questions.explanation: The present perfect tense 'has gone' is required with the time marker 'since + past time point'.

questions.question: In an extended family, traditional values held by elderly grandparents can occasionally trigger a _______ conflict with modern adolescents.
questions.explanation: 'Generational conflict' denotes disputes or differences in viewpoint between people of different age generations.

questions.question: You _______ stay out past 10 p.m. without permission because our parents have set a strict house curfew.
questions.explanation: 'Mustn't' expresses a strong prohibition or rule that must not be broken.

questions.question: Parents should strive to be open-_______ and listen attentively when their children voice unconventional opinions.
questions.explanation: 'Open-minded' is a compound adjective describing willingness to consider new and different ideas.

questions.question: All students _______ wear the school uniform on Mondays; it is an obligatory school regulation.
questions.explanation: 'Have to' expresses external obligation imposed by external authority or institutional rules.

questions.question: Living in a nuclear family typically means residing only with one's _______ and siblings.
questions.explanation: A nuclear family consists strictly of two generations: parents and their dependent offspring.

questions.question: Teenagers frequently complain that their elders hold overly _______ views regarding contemporary fashion and music.
questions.explanation: 'Conservative' describes beliefs that favor tradition and oppose sudden change.

questions.question: Eco-friendly smart cities will prioritize _______ energy solutions like photovoltaic solar cells and wind turbines.
questions.explanation: 'Renewable energy' comes from natural resources that replenish themselves without running out.

questions.question: Autonomous electric shuttles are deployed across modern campuses to alleviate severe traffic _______.
questions.explanation: 'Traffic congestion' refers to roadways clogged with excessive vehicular movement.

questions.question: Air quality in tomorrow's urban centers will improve significantly due to extensive rooftop _______ and green vertical facades.
questions.explanation: 'Rooftop gardens' provide vegetation that absorbs carbon dioxide and cools metropolitan buildings.

questions.question: Sensors embedded along metropolitan streets will automatically dim illumination to _______ electrical power during late hours.
questions.explanation: 'Conserve' means to protect from harm or use sparingly to prevent depletion.

questions.question: Demographers forecast that by 2050, roughly two-thirds of humanity _______ in major metropolitan centers.
questions.explanation: Future continuous 'will be living' emphasizes an ongoing state or activity in progress at a specific future timeframe.

questions.question: Choose the word whose primary stress is positioned differently from the other three:
questions.explanation: 'futuristic' has stress on the 3rd syllable (/ˌfjuːtʃəˈrɪstɪk/), while renewable, pedestrian, and sustainable have stress on the 2nd syllable.
